blocks.text: Curated is the first publication from Mouraux Durand-Ruel Gallery ; it is an edition of 100 copies signed by the artist’s daughter, Anne Clergue . Curated is published on the occasion of the gallery’s inaugural exhibition, Lucien Clergue: Written by the Sun , on view through October 31, 2026.
Lucien Clergue: Written by the Sun Until October 31, 2026 Mouraux Durand-Ruel Gallery 555 W 25th St, 3rd floor New York, NY 10001 www.mourauxdurandruel.com
